description: This file defines the internal class 'InMemoryMembershipTable' used to manage membership information in memory within the Orleans.Runtimemembership service. It provides methods for reading, inserting, updating, and cleaning up silo membership data, maintaining a table version and ETag counter for concurrency control.

classes.name: InMemoryMembershipTable
classes.description: An internal class that manages silo membership data in memory, supporting read, insert, update, and cleanup operations, with concurrency control through versioning and ETags.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Retrieves membership data for a specific silo address.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Returns all membership entries in the table.

methods.name: ReadTableVersion
methods.description: Returns the current version of the membership table.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a new membership entry if it does not exist and version matches.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing membership entry if ETag and version match.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a specific silo.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the table contents and ETag counter.

methods.name: NewETag
methods.description: Generates a new ETag string based on the last counter.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes entries for silos marked as dead and inactive before a given date.
